shortDescription: One helper for the whole household. It remembers what each person needs and follows up.
fullDescription: Kitchen Table remembers what each person in your household needs, across days and across people. Ask what's new and it tells you what others are waiting on, suggests where it fits in your plans, and asks before changing anything. When you say yes, it updates the errand list and lets the other parent know. Demo build: no purchases are made.
examplePhrases: Alexa, tell Kitchen Table I need poster board for the science fair on Sunday
Alexa, ask Kitchen Table if there's anything I should know
Alexa, ask Kitchen Table what's on the Saturday errand run
Alexa, tell Kitchen Table I got the poster board
